crime: Every dusk, a girl who had once taught the little ones at her mother's dance school taught the waltz on the courtyard paths, counting the steps aloud. Every evening, she asked {WITCH_NAME} to join.
One dusk, {WITCH_NAME} missed the count. The girl let go of her hand, took another partner, and laughed. "You keep the count for us."
At school, the girls in her class had handed her the end of the skipping rope every break. "You turn. You've got strong arms." She turned it for years and never once jumped in.
In front of the dancers, she slapped her palm to the ground. A head-high ring of thorned roses burst up around her.

After the girls went in, the waltz teacher stayed behind, as she did every night, to soak her feet in the fountain. {WITCH_NAME} held her under the water, counting aloud, one, two, three, until she was still.

Just before lockup, as the girls found the waltz teacher in the fountain, {WITCH_NAME} tore her way out through the front of the ring, bleeding. The prisoners walked all the way around it and found it whole except for that gap. She had been sealed inside all evening, they decided.

Then one of them reached deep into the back of the ring. On a snapped cane, beneath whole canes in fresh bloom, hung a tuft of grey from {WITCH_NAME}'s sleeve. In the trial court, the prisoners understood: she had torn her way out through the back, then grown the briar back over the break.
fields.epitaph: The only count she ever kept in time was for a girl who would never dance again.
fields.epithet: The Rope-Turner Who Never Jumped In
execution: The execution stand raises a head-high ring of living rose briar around her. It begins to close in waltz time, three steps to every bar, and she steps with it, always a beat late. She tears at the canes with her bare arms, the way she tore her way out of her own ring in the courtyard. The ring closes faster, and its thorns drive into her. At last it has closed into a single pillar of briar in full bloom. Nothing inside it moves.

magic.name: Briar Rose
magic.text: Her touch makes a dense hedge of thorned roses burst into bloom from any floor or wall.
